verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is a local Agent Skill: a SKILL.md folder with dependency-free Python tools that runs inside a host agent. It is not a hosted service that emits events, so subscribing to events via registrable outbound webhooks is outside this product type's axis. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any webhook or event-subscription capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
